name: Static Field Only: No Radiation
description: Disable the dynamic field to see only the static Coulomb field. Toggle Dynamic back on to see the dramatic difference: only accelerating charges radiate EM waves. A charge at rest or moving at constant velocity produces no radiation.

successCriteria.description: Observe flat line (no wave) when dynamic field is off
Enable dynamic field and observe wave pattern appear

hints.message: With Dynamic field OFF, the electron still oscillates but creates no propagating wave.
Toggle Dynamic ON to see the wave appear. Only accelerating charges radiate!
